text:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — thinking about switching to path-stable routes + search params for panel/drawer state. Proposal: regroup left nav into Home / Workspaces / Models / Observability / Deployments / Billing and encode right-panel state as query params (eg. ?panel=logs&view=timeline). Goals: cleaner SSR, shareable canonical links, and fewer nested resource paths. Thoughts? :mag:

Rajiv S.: Seems sensible. Two engineering notes: 1) history noise — if we push a new history entry for every tiny UI toggle we’ll fill back/forward; use replaceState for ephemeral toggles and pushState only for deliberate navigations. 2) we need a canonical param whitelist on the server so permalinks don’t leak dev flags.

Elena G.: A11y nits: skip-link target must point to the currently active main panel (not left nav). When breadcrumbs update announce via an aria-live polite region: "Navigated to Models, model-xyz, revision 42". Avoid moving focus unless the user explicitly opened the panel with keyboard/Enter.

Ben L.: Microcopy + mobile: breadcrumbs should be truncated in the bar with full name in aria-label / tooltip. On mobile collapse into a single pill that opens a bottom sheet showing the full path + copy link action. Also add a small "Copy link" button on the breadcrumb that copies the canonicalized URL.

Maya Chen: Example permalinks I'm proposing: ```
https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=latency&range=24h
https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-xyz?panel=history&entry=12345
```Shareable params: panel, metric, range, revision. Non-shareable: debugging toggles, live-dev flags.

Rajiv S.: Implementation checklist suggestion: 
- Decide canonical param set (server-side canonicalizePermalink)
- Push vs replace history rules (user-click => push, UI toggle => replace)
- Map deep-linkable actions to analytics events so we can track broken permalinks
I'll spike this and sketch the router hooks.

Elena G.: Breadcrumb keyboard behavior: use role="toolbar" around crumbs, every crumb is an anchor/button, last crumb gets aria-current="page". Tooltips must be accessible (aria-describedby) and not rely on hover. Avoid auto-opening flyouts on focus.

Ben L.: Visual idea: show chevrons with truncation (e.g., Models > model-xyz… > rev 42). Hover shows full name + small copy icon. For long model ids show a monospace copy button in the tooltip. Figma mock incoming: <https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/breadcrumb-mobile-sheet> :rocket:

AccessibilityBot: Reminder: add axe-core checks and keyboard-only e2e flows. Suggested tests: skiplink lands on active panel, breadcrumb Enter navigates, aria-live announces path changes, focus order preserved when closing panels.

Maya Chen: Action items (owners): Rajiv - spike for history + canonicalization (due Tue), Elena - write accessiblity acceptance tests + live-region copy, Ben - mocks for mobile pill + tooltip copy, Maya - spec for canonicalization rules and share button copy. Can we target a small experiment next sprint?

Rajiv S.: :thumbsup: I'll create a short RFC in eng-platform with examples and a small prototype route middleware.

Elena G.: I'll draft the a11y checklist and add it to the PR template.

Ben L.: Will post Figma and three copy variants for the breadcrumb and share tooltip tomorrow.

AccessibilityBot: Pinned: "NAV-77: Breadcrumb accessibility checklist" and scheduled a11y review meeting for next Wed.
